digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery and diagnostics
propositions: The step-budget repetition diagnostic is computed by interpret_failure but discarded before reaching the surface because raise_completion_workflow_failure is not called when budget exhaustion fails outside CompletionAgentStep._recover

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist strips tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, and distinct_ratio_window before they reach the gate_error_v1 sidecar, preventing operators from distinguishing loop behavior from actual budget constraint

The operator-facing close-gate failure message lacks the distinct-vs-total tool-call counts, making it impossible to differentiate looping (observable via repetition counters) from genuine budget exhaustion without inspecting logs
The _bounded_diagnostic merge guards only permit scalar values, causing list-typed top_repeated_tool_calls to be dropped even if allowlisted

The diagnostic must survive the primary-exception merge with aggregate_ prefix rebranding while format_repetition expects bare key names, requiring a projection step in raise_completion_workflow_failure
